summary: Allocates and populates two linked lists on this container. Builds a 2036-byte block holding two 1016-byte sub-chunks initialized by DualCallWrapper_4f50, appends a node referencing it to the first list, then appends one node per nonzero 1016-stride pointer from the block into the second list. Returns the last allocation.

operations.description: allocate 4-byte pointer block via heap allocator
if pointer-block allocation failed, short-circuit the whole body
store header value 2 at block start
initialize the two 1016-byte sub-chunks via DualCallWrapper_4f50
store block pointer into the 4-byte pointer block
allocate 12-byte list node for the first list
initialize first-list node: data pointer at +0, previous 0 at +4, flag 1 at +8
branch on whether first-list head pointer at +0x0 is set
empty first list: set head at +0x0 and current pointer at +0x8 to the node
link node into first list: update tail at +0x4 and increment count at +0xC
iterate block offsets 0 to 2032 in steps of 1016; guard each nonzero offset pointer
allocate 12-byte list node for the second list
initialize second-list node: data pointer at +0, previous 0 at +4, flag 0 at +8
branch on whether second-list head pointer at +0x10 is set
empty second list: set anchor at +0x14 and secondary pointer at +0x18 to the node
link node into second list: update head at +0x10 and increment count at +0x1C
